translation_en: a thousand congratulations
congratulations on what you did (marriage/engagement)
wishing completion and perfection in marriage
may it happen to all those who wish for it
may you be next (to a male)
wishing for the complete wedding joy
may you celebrate their prosperity / big days
may you find blessing through her
may you find blessing through him
wishing peace, comfort, and offspring
a lifetime marriage God willing
may God bring it to a happy completion
may God bless you both
may God let us celebrate your wedding soon (m)
may God let us celebrate your wedding soon (f)
may God grant you happiness and bliss

translit: allah yurzoqkom el zorriyyeh el saliha
translation_en: may God grant you righteous offspring
looking like the full moon tonight (m)
looking gorgeous like the moon tonight (f)
they suit each other perfectly
God protect you (admiration to groom)
this is the wedding of the century
may all your days be filled with joy
crown them with joy and happiness
looking forward to celebrating your kids' weddings
may your homes always be full of celebrations
we celebrated and tied the knot
strike the tambourines / begin festivities
ululate with joy, mother of the groom!
our lovely bride has appeared
so beautiful together
may he be raised in your honor and care (m)
may she be raised in your honor and care (f)
may the child be raised in your family's glory
thank God for your wife's safe delivery

arabic: حَمْدِ الله عَلَى سَلَامِة أُمّ العَبْد
arabic_plain: حمد الله على سلامة أم العبد
translation_en: thank God for the mother's safe recovery
may God preserve him for you
may God preserve her for you
congratulations on the new baby boy
congratulations on the new baby girl

translit: allah yaj3alha men banat el salameh
allah yij3alha men bnat es slameh
translation_en: may God make her among the blessed healthy girls

translit: allah yaj3alo men mawaleed el sa3adeh
allah yij3alo men mawaleed es sa3ade
translation_en: may God make the newborn full of bliss and fortune
he has become a grown young man
a darling sweet angel (piece of sugar)
wishing you health and a thousand safeties (m)
may he be safe and see no evil
safety to your heart (wishing well / comfort m)
may it purify you of sins God willing
wishing spiritual reward and restored health
may God cure you and grant you good health (m)
may God cure you and grant you good health (f)
may no harm or evil touch you (m)
may no harm or evil touch you (f)
keep harm far outside and away
may God pardon and heal you
thank God for your safety and recovery
may God protect you from every harm
strength and health God willing
this hardship is temporary and will pass
it is a crisis and will pass smoothly
material sacrifice is nothing compared to your legs/safety
loss of money is nothing compared to loss of family
may God raise you up safely from sickbed (m)
how are you feeling today? (m)
how are you feeling today? (f)
reassure us about your health (m)
reassure us about your health (f)
our hearts were with you
we rejoiced greatly at your recovery
you brightened your home again by returning healthy
may you never see harm happen to a loved one
may God make it an expiation of sins

translit: yowmayn w bterja3 zayy el hisan
translation_en: in two days you'll be back as strong as a horse
it is our duty to check on you
may God magnify your reward in grief
may God accept your striving (response to condolence)
may what remains of life be added to yours (m)
may your life be everlasting (standard response m)
may God have mercy on him and forgive him
may God have mercy on her and strengthen her
may God grant patience to your hearts

translit: inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji3oon
ena lelah w ena elehi raj3on
translation_en: to God we belong and to Him we return
may this be the conclusion of your griefs
may you never be bereaved of a cherished one
may his final abode be Paradise
may her final resting place be Paradise
may God make Paradise his resting abode
the dearly departed one
God's mercy be upon him
God's mercy be upon her
he left honorable men behind him
he who leaves worthy offspring does not truly die
God's divine will has been carried out

arabic: مَا فِي شِي بِيْغْلَى عَلَى رَبُّه
arabic_plain: ما في شي بيغلى على ربه
translit: ma fi shi bye5la ala rabbo
translation_en: nothing is too precious for his Lord to reclaim
permanence belongs to God alone
eternity belongs to God alone
he lived content and well-esteemed
he passed away peacefully of natural causes
may God compensate you with blessing
may God steadfast him during the inquiry of the grave

arabic: مِن أَهْل الجَنَّة إِنْ شَاءَ الله
arabic_plain: من أهل الجنة إن شاء الله
translation_en: among the dwellers of Paradise God willing
may God lighten the earth above his resting soul
his memory will forever remain with us
his reputation smells sweet among people
you lit up the whole house with your presence
make yourselves at home (the house is yours)
welcome, honored to have you all
blessing itself has visited us
we are honored to see you all
someone who never fails social courtesies (m)
someone who never fails social courtesies (f)
may God multiply your abundance (m)
you troubled yourselves far too much for us
there is no trouble between close family/friends
may your hospitality and table always endure
may this feast table always be abundant
health and vitality to your heart (m)
bless your hands for what you prepared (m)
may God preserve your beloved family
may you be safe and well every year
may you return to celebrate it year after year
among God's righteous servants
congratulations on the newcomer/new blessing
may God grant you success in your life together
you deserve every blessing and good thing (m)
you deserve every blessing and good thing (f)
may the home of your joys always flourish

translit: mennak el mal w menha el 3iyal
mennak el mal w menha el eyal
translation_en: from you the wealth, from her the children (traditional proverb)
wishing you the highest academic degree
you made your parents proud (m)
you made your parents proud (f)
you honored us and made our faces shine white (m)
this is the day of supreme wishes fulfilled
happy birthday
wishing you to reach one hundred years

translit: omr madid bel se77a w el hana
translation_en: a long life in radiant health and happiness
may the Lord preserve you all for us
a stick in the envious eye (warding off envy)
five and fivefold amulet protection around you
may God protect you from every evil eye

arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِالله
arabic_plain: لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله
translit: la hawla wala qowwata illa billah
translation_en: there is no might and no power except with God
What do you have available today?
What do you recommend to us?
Make us two shawarma wraps please

arabic: وَاحَد شَاوِرْمَا جَاج مَع تّوم زْيَادِة
arabic_plain: واحد شاورما جاج مع توم زيادة
translit: wa7ad shawarma jaj ma3 toum zyadeh
wa7ed shawarma djej ma3 toum ziede
translation_en: One chicken shawarma with extra garlic sauce
Wrap it for me in saj flatbread

arabic: بِدِّي لَفِّة فَلَافِل مَع كِلّ شِي
arabic_plain: بدي لفة فلافل مع كل شي
translit: biddi laffet falafel ma3 kill shi
badde laffet falafele ma3 kel shi
translation_en: I want a falafel sandwich with everything in it
Without pickles if possible
Put extra tahini for me please
I want it extra spicy hot
Without any hot chili at all
Takeaway or for here?
No, takeaway please
Dine-in, we are going to sit here
What would you like to drink alongside it?
Bring me one cold ayran drink

translit: sahn hummus ma3 lahmeh w snawbar
translation_en: A plate of hummus topped with fried minced meat and pine nuts
Fix us up with a large bowl of fattoush

translit: bidna sahn tabbouleh hamdah w mzayyateh
translation_en: We want a tabbouleh salad nice, tangy and well-oiled
Could we also have another hot loaf of pita?
Dip/drench the bread for me in the savoury meat juices
Serve us a dozen piping hot falafel balls
I want a mixed kilo of grilled skewers
Make sure to include the salads and mezze along with it

translit: kam waqt bidda et-talabiyeh la tijhaz?
kam wa2et badda t-talabiye la tejhaz?
translation_en: How long will the order take to be ready?

translit: shi rib' sa'ah w btikoon jahzeh
chi reb3 sa3a w btkoun jehze
translation_en: Around a quarter of an hour and it will be ready
May God give you health, boss/chef
May He grant you health, welcome!
Good evening to you all
Is there an empty table for four?
Is there outdoor seating on the terrace/balcony?
Please come in, this table is ready
Could we have the menu please?
What appetizers / mezze do you have available today?

translit: nazzilna hummus w mutabbal w fattoush
translation_en: Serve us hummus, smoked eggplant dip and fattoush
At your discerning taste, chef / Surprise us with your best
Bring us half a boneless grilled chicken
I want the meat well done
Don't char it, keep it tender and juicy
Could we get a plate of French fries?
Add a few more pickles for me if you please

arabic: الصَّحِن بَيَّض، كِلّ شِي كَان بْيِشَهِّي
arabic_plain: الصحن بيض، كل شي كان بيشهي
translit: es-sahn bayyad, kill shi kan byishahhi
es-sa7en bayyad, kel shi ken byechhe
translation_en: The plate was wiped clean, everything was utterly delicious!
Health and bliss to your heart! (Bon appétit / Enjoy)
Bless your hands for this wonderful meal
Bless the hands that prepared this
The bill please
How much is our bill, dear host? (polite question to the cashier)
Your bill is covered, it is on the house! (polite hospitality gesture)
May God preserve you, by God I won't hear of it (insisting on paying)
Keep the change for yourself

arabic: فِيك تْجِيبْلِي صُنْدُوق سَفَرِي لَبَاقِي الأَكْل؟
arabic_plain: فيك تجيبلي صندوق سفري لباقي الأكل؟
translit: feek tjeebli sundooq safari la baqi el-akl?
fik tjible sendou2 safari la be2i l-akel?
translation_en: Could you bring me a takeaway container for the remaining food?
What would you like for dessert after the meal?
Bring us a platter of Nabulsi knafeh

translit: biddi yaha khishneh w jibnetha btimtot
translation_en: I want it coarse knafeh with stretchy melted cheese
Drizzle a bit more sugar syrup on it for me
Don't put too much syrup, keep it lightly sweet
Sprinkle crushed Aleppo pistachios over the top
Give us a street sesame pocket stuffed with halawat al-jibn

arabic: هَاتْلْنَا رَبْطِة خُبْز سُخُن مِن الفُرْن
arabic_plain: هاتلنا ربطة خبز سخن من الفرن
translit: hatilna rabtet khobz sokhon min el-forn
hatelna rab6et 5obz se5en mn el fern
translation_en: Fetch us a warm bundle of bread straight from the oven
The pies are coming out piping hot and sizzling crisp

translit: wahdeh za'tar ma' khodrah w zaytoon
translation_en: One thyme manousheh with fresh vegetables and olives

translit: manqoushet jibneh mix akkawi w qashqawan
translation_en: A cheese manousheh with a blend of Akkawi and Kashkaval
Squeeze a lemon wedge over the plate for me
This dish is way too salty
The dressing is lacking a bit of tanginess/lemon
Could you heat the sandwich a little more for me?
Press it on the griddle until it becomes crispy

arabic: قَعْدَة القَهْوَة مَا بْتِكْمَل بِلَا أَرْكِيلِة
arabic_plain: قعدة القهوة ما بتكمل بلا أركيلة
translit: qa'det el-qahweh ma btikmal bila argileh
translation_en: A café gathering isn't complete without a hookah
What shisha molasses flavors do you have?
Bring me a double-apple hookah to your taste
Could we get a fresh head / bowl change please?
Quickly bring us a hot burning coal ember
The heat is fading, replace the coals
The hookah pull is way too harsh and heavy
Give me a fresh plastic mouth tip if you please
Pour us a demitasse of unsweetened black cardamom coffee
May your hospitality coffee flow forever
Drink your coffee before it goes cold
Make us two glasses of hot sage-infused tea
The tea is overly sweetened

arabic: بِدِّي شَاي خَفِيف سُكَّر عَلَى جَنْب
arabic_plain: بدي شاي خفيف سكر على جنب
translit: biddi shai khafeef sokkar ala jamb
translation_en: I want black tea light, with the sugar on the side
A glass of deeply steeped tea that clears the head
Welcome, you have brought light to our shop!
The house is yours, please relax and make yourselves at home
What do you crave for us to cook you for lunch?

arabic: نَفَسَك بِالأَكْل مَا شَاء الله بْيِجَنِّن
arabic_plain: نفسك بالأكل ما شاء الله بيجنن
translit: nafasak bil-akl ma sha allah byijannin
nafasik bel akel ma cha allah byjannen
translation_en: Your culinary touch and seasoning in food is mesmerizing!
The dish is prepared with true culinary love and soul

arabic: طَبْخ البَيْت مَا فِي أَلَذّ مِنُّو
arabic_plain: طبخ البيت ما في ألذ منو
translit: tabkh el-beit ma fee alazz minno
6ab5 el bet ma fi a7la menno
tab5 l-bet ma fi atyab menno
translation_en: Home cooking has no equal in deliciousness
May your table always be spread and your home ever thriving!
I don't have room for a single additional bite!
Just one single bite for my sake!
The food was completely finished down to the last scrap
Brew us a cup of traditional wild mountain herbal tea
Bring a glass of ice-cold water
The water is freezing cold, cutting through the throat
Put the sauce on the side
Could you change this fork for me?
Where is the washbasin / restroom sink please?
Do you want to pay the bill cash or card?
No, cash is better
Keep the change as a tip for yourself

translit: chou naw3 l-jebne lli bel man2ouche?
translation_en: What kind of cheese is in the manousheh?
A thin and crispy dough crust

arabic: نَزِّلْلِي وَاحِد صَحِن مُسَبَّحَة مَع زَيْت زَيْتُون
arabic_plain: نزللي واحد صحن مسبحة مع زيت زيتون
translit: nazzilli wahid sahn msabbaha ma3 zayt zaytoon
nazelle wa7ed sa7en mseba7a ma3 zet zetoun
translation_en: Serve me a plate of whole-chickpea hummus drenched in olive oil
Add plenty of cumin to the fava beans
Let the local clarified ghee sizzle piping hot over the bowl

arabic: حَبَّات الفَلَافِل مْقَرْمِشِة مِن بَرَّا وَطَرِيِّة مِن جُوَّا
arabic_plain: حبات الفلافل مقرمشة من برا وطرية من جوا
translit: habbat el-falafel mqarmisheh min barra w tariyeh min gowwa
7abbat l-falafele m2armche mn barra w tariye mn jouwwa
translation_en: The falafel balls are crunchy on the outside and tender inside
Remove the pickles from my wrap

translit: hal shawarma ra2am wa7ed bel balad
translation_en: This shawarma is number one in the whole city
The shawarma spit is glistening brilliantly
Carve for me from the browned, roasted outer edges
Make it a double wrap please
Give us a cold fresh sugarcane juice
Fresh hand-squeezed orange juice
How many falafel patties go in the sandwich?

arabic: حُطِّلْهَا أَرْبَع حَبَّات مَع رَشِّة سُمَّاق
arabic_plain: حطلها أربع حبات مع رشة سماق
translit: hottilha arba' habbat ma' rashet summaq
translation_en: Put four pieces in it with a dusting of sumac

arabic: خَفِّف زَيْت شْوَيّ الله يْرَضَى عَلَيْك
arabic_plain: خفف زيت شوي الله يرضى عليك
translit: khaffif zayt shwayy allah yirda alayk
translation_en: Go easy on the oil, may God be pleased with you

translit: baddak tasqiyeh bi samneh walla bi zayt?
baddak tas2iye b semne walla b zet?
translation_en: Do you want the Damascene chickpea fatteh with hot ghee or olive oil?

translit: bi samneh baladiyeh ma' lawz mhammas
b semne baladieh ma3 lawz m7ammas
translation_en: With local artisanal ghee and toasted almonds
The flavor is so intensely delicious it hits right in the forehead!
What kind of tea do you carry?

arabic: عِنْدْنَا شَاي كَرَك وَشَاي خَضِر وَشَاي بِمَرْمَرِيِّة
arabic_plain: عندنا شاي كرك وشاي خضر وشاي بمرمرية
translit: indna shai karak w shai khadir w shai bi marmariyeh
3endna shay karak w shay a5dar w shay b maramieh
translation_en: We have karak spiced tea, green tea, and sage black tea
Bring us a lemon-mint hookah
The charcoal has turned to ash, change it please

arabic: مَا بْتِقْصَر يَا مْعَلِّم، كِلَّك ذَوْق
arabic_plain: ما بتقصر يا معلم، كلك ذوق
translit: ma btiqsar ya m'allam, killak zawq
ma bte2sor ya m3allem, kellak zo2
translation_en: You never fail to deliver boss, you are all grace and class
Double health and vigor to your hearts!
May God grant health to your body! (Standard response to sihha w afyeh)
May God multiply your bounty and compensate you generously
At your service, one minute and it will be right with you
Our order has been delayed for a long time
It is our fault, your order is coming out right now immediately
Treat him to a coffee on the house

arabic: أَكْل الشَّوَارِع هُون مَا فِي مِثْلُو
arabic_plain: أكل الشوارع هون ما في مثلو
translit: akl esh-shawari' hon ma fee mithlo
akel ech-chawere3 hon ma fi metlo
translation_en: The street food here has no comparison anywhere
The aroma of freshly fried falafel is wafting through the neighborhood

arabic: طَلِّع القَطَايِف مِن الزَّيْت وَسَقِّطْهَا بِالقَطِر
arabic_plain: طلع القطايف من الزيت وسقطها بالقطر
translit: talli' el-qatayef min ez-zayt w saqqitha bil-ater
6alle3 l-2a6ayef mn ez-zet w sa22e6ha bel 2a6er
translation_en: Take the qatayef out of the oil and drop them straight into sugar syrup

translit: hashwet jawz w qirfeh law samaht
translation_en: Walnut and cinnamon filling please

arabic: جِبْنِة حِلْوِة مَغْسُولَة مْنِيح مِن المِلْح
arabic_plain: جبنة حلوة مغسولة منيح من الملح
translit: jibneh helweh maghsouleh mnih min el-milh
jebne 7elwe ma8soule mni7 mn el mel7
translation_en: Sweet desalted cheese thoroughly soaked to remove salinity

arabic: كُوبَايِة سَحْلَب سُخْنِة مَع قِرْفَة وَجَوْز هِنْد
arabic_plain: كوباية سحلب سخنة مع قرفة وجوز هند
translit: kobbayet sahlab sokhneh ma' qirfeh w jawz hind
kobbayet sa7lab se5ne ma3 2erfe w joz hend
translation_en: A steaming cup of sahlab pudding with cinnamon and shredded coconut
This eatery is constantly packed with customers
A queue at the bakery door in the morning
Give us a kilo of sesame street rings/bread
Toast the cheese-filled kaakeh over glowing charcoal
The food truly whets the appetite

arabic: مَا شَاء الله كِلّ شِي أُصُول
arabic_plain: ما شاء الله كل شي أصول
translit: ma sha allah kill shi oosool
ma cha allah kel shi soulo
translation_en: Everything is prepared strictly according to authentic culinary tradition

arabic: عَ جَنْب التَّبُّولِة لَازِم خَسّ وَوَرَق مَلْفُوف
arabic_plain: ع جنب التبولة لازم خس وورق ملفوف
translit: a jamb et-tabbouleh lazim khass w waraq malfoof
3a janb et-tabboule lezem 5as w wara2 malfouf
translation_en: Alongside tabbouleh, fresh romaine lettuce and crisp cabbage leaves are essential
Levantine cooking is full of blessing and abundance
Pass me the salt shaker
Add a little more garlic to the cabbage rolls

arabic: سَكِّرْلِي السَّنْدْوِيشَة مْنِيح تَ مَا تِفْرُط
arabic_plain: سكرلي السندويشة منيح ت ما تفرط
translit: sakkirli es-sandwisheh mnih ta ma tifrot
sakkerle s-sandwishe mni7 ta ma tefrot
translation_en: Tightly fold the wrap so it doesn't fall apart
The tahini sauce is dripping all down our hands (hallmark of good street shawarma)
Grab yourself a napkin and wipe your hands

arabic: خَلِّينَا نِطْلُب كَمَان صَحِن قَبْل مَا نْقُوم
arabic_plain: خلينا نطلب كمان صحن قبل ما نقوم
translit: khalleena nitlob kaman sahn qabl ma nqoom
translation_en: Let's order another plate before we leave

arabic: لَا تْسْتَعْجِل، خَلِّينَا نْرَوْوِق عَلَى القَهْوَة
arabic_plain: لا تستعجل، خلينا نرووق على القهوة
translit: la tista'jil, khalleena nrawwiq ala el-qahweh
translation_en: Don't rush, let's take our time savoring the coffee
A tranquil sitting and a wonderful ambience
The courtyard restaurant smells of Damascus jasmine
Pour for the honored guest before anyone else
Long live whoever gets to see you, dear friend! (Warm greeting at café)
Reassure us about how you are, what are you drinking?
I ordered a glass of tea for you along with mine
May your bounty increase, you are always exemplary in courtesy
This is legendary generosity (like Hatim al-Tai)
Don't make me swear an oath, your bill is already paid

arabic: وَلله مَا بْيِطْلَعْلَك تِدْفَع وَأَنَا مَوْجُود
arabic_plain: ولله ما بيطلعلك تدفع وأنا موجود
translit: wallah ma byitla'lak tidfa' w ana mawjood
wallah ma byetla3lak tedfa3 w ana mawjoud
translation_en: By God you are not allowed to pay while I am present!
Your invitation is accepted, next time it is at our place

translit: alf sihha w huna ala qalbak
translation_en: A thousand health and bliss upon your heart
May God honor and elevate you with generosity
May your dining table always flourish in the presence of its loved ones

translit: b sa77et sidna w ech-chabab et-tayybe
translation_en: To the health of our master and all the good folks gathered
May we soon return the favor at your happy celebrations

arabic: شُو هَاللُّقْمَة الطَّيِّبَة اللِّي بْتِفْتَح النِّفْس!
arabic_plain: شو هاللقمة الطيبة اللي بتفتح النفس!
translit: shu hal-luqmeh et-tayyibeh elli btiftah en-nifs!
chou hal le2me et-taybe lli btefta7 en-nafas!
translation_en: What a mouthwatering delicious bite that opens the appetite!

translit: teslam idin lli laff hal sandwiche
translation_en: Bless the hands of whoever rolled this sandwich

arabic: مَا شَاء الله، الإِيد اللِّي طَبَخَت تِتْلَفّ بِحَرِير
arabic_plain: ما شاء الله، الإيد اللي طبخت تتلف بحرير
translit: ma sha allah, el-eed elli tabakhat titlaff bi-hareer
ma cha allah, l-id lli 6aba5et tetlaff b 7arir
